# Vendored UI components

Copied from the component registries (shadcn registry format), then adapted to the app's
colour tokens. Each file's header says what changed.

| Component | Source | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `reactbits/CountUp.tsx` | ReactBits — `CountUp-TS-TW` (verbatim) | Animated KPI numbers |
| `reactbits/SpotlightCard.tsx` | ReactBits — `SpotlightCard-TS-TW` | KPI tiles and notice cards (cursor spotlight) |
| `watermelon/continuous-tabs.tsx` | WatermelonUI — `continuous-tabs` | Filter / view tabs (spring "pill") |
| `watermelon/command-search.tsx` | WatermelonUI — `command-search` | Ctrl+K command palette (patients, pages, actions) |

Registries: https://reactbits.dev/r/registry.json · https://ui.watermelon.sh/r/registry.json
